statements.text: Recurrent processing is activity in which higher areas feed back to lower areas through feedback and horizontal connections, and the lower areas feed forward to the higher ones again, amplifying the signal. In the theory it follows the feedforward sweep.

sources.quote: as recurrent processing, in which higher areas feed back to lower areas, which in turn feed forward to the higher areas again, thereby amplifying the signal
Subsequently, recurrent processing is instantiated by horizontal and feedback connections.
